apps.name: Crayfish Fight Monitor
apps.description: Crayfish aggression monitoring for aquaculture tanks. Detects every animal, votes its sex, and classifies fight / harass behaviour on the interaction ROI of any pair that stays close -- screened per frame, then confirmed by an 8-frame temporal classifier that sees the motion. Reports events (never video) plus a quota-limited image dump for retraining.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 水槽螯虾行为监测：逐帧检测每只虾并投票判定性别，对持续靠近的虾对在交互 ROI 上分类 fight / harass 行为——单帧粗筛，再由 8 帧时序分类器看运动做确认；只上报事件（视频不出场），并按配额落盘图片用于再训练。

apps.name: Depth Estimation
apps.description: Monocular relative depth over the live camera. Runs MiDaS v2.1 small (256x256, FP16) on the RV1126B NPU and publishes frame depth statistics, a near/mid/far zone grid and the nearest zone in frame. Depth is relative and unitless -- nothing here is a distance in metres.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 实时单目相对深度。在 RV1126B NPU 上运行 MiDaS v2.1 small（256×256 FP16），输出整帧深度统计、近/中/远网格分区与画面中最近的分区。深度为相对值、无单位，不代表实际距离。

apps.name: F1 Door Access
apps.description: On-device 1:N face identification. SCRFD-500M finds every face and its five landmarks, each face is warped to the canonical 112x112 ArcFace pose and embedded to 512 dimensions, and the embedding is matched against an enrolled gallery by cosine similarity. Faces are tracked, so a reported identity is the argmax of the evidence accumulated over that person's frames rather than one frame's nearest neighbour, and faces too small to embed reliably are gated out instead of matched to whoever happens to be closest. An optional MiniFASNet anti-spoofing head suppresses printed photos and phone screens: a face that fails liveness contributes no evidence at all. Enrollment runs over a loopback HTTP command channel, from the live camera or from a posted still. No image and no embedding leaves the device.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 设备端 1:N 人脸识别。SCRFD-500M 检出每张人脸及五个关键点，按标准 112x112 ArcFace 姿态做相似变换对齐后提取 512 维特征，再与已注册人脸库做余弦比对。人脸带跟踪，报告的身份是该人多帧证据累积后的最高票，而不是单帧最近邻；过小的人脸直接门控跳过，而不是硬匹配到最接近的那个人。可选的 MiniFASNet 活体检测用于抑制照片与手机屏幕翻拍：未通过活体的帧不贡献任何证据。注册通过本地回环 HTTP 指令通道完成，支持实时摄像头采集与上传静态图两种来源。图像与特征均不出设备。

apps.name: Face Analysis
apps.description: On-device audience analytics with a three-stage face cascade: a YOLOv8n-face detector finds every face, then per face a FairFace classifier (age band / gender / race) and an 8-class emotion model run on the cropped 224x224 ROI. Emits per-face attribute events plus a simple time-windowed demographic aggregation (gender / age / race / emotion histograms). Privacy-first: faces can be flagged for blurring and no image leaves the device. Reuses the reCamera Pro cascade-pipeline pattern first shipped by facemesh-reader.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 设备端客群分析，采用三级人脸级联：YOLOv8n-face 检测每一张脸，随后对每张脸在裁剪的 224x224 ROI 上运行 FairFace 分类器（年龄段/性别/种族）与 8 类情绪模型。输出每张脸的属性事件，以及简单的分时段客群聚合（性别/年龄/种族/情绪直方图）。隐私优先：可标记人脸进行模糊，且图像不出设备。复用 facemesh-reader 首发的 reCamera Pro 级联流水线范式。

apps.name: Face Recognition
apps.description: On-device 1:N face identification. SCRFD-500M finds every face and its five landmarks, each face is warped to the canonical 112x112 ArcFace pose and embedded to 512 dimensions, and the embedding is matched against an enrolled gallery by cosine similarity. Faces are tracked, so a reported identity is the argmax of the evidence accumulated over that person's frames rather than one frame's nearest neighbour, and faces too small to embed reliably are gated out instead of matched to whoever happens to be closest. An optional MiniFASNet anti-spoofing head suppresses printed photos and phone screens: a face that fails liveness contributes no evidence at all. Enrollment runs over a loopback HTTP command channel, from the live camera or from a posted still. No image and no embedding leaves the device.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 设备端 1:N 人脸识别。SCRFD-500M 检出每张人脸及五个关键点，按标准 112x112 ArcFace 姿态做相似变换对齐后提取 512 维特征，再与已注册人脸库做余弦比对。人脸带跟踪，报告的身份是该人多帧证据累积后的最高票，而不是单帧最近邻；过小的人脸直接门控跳过，而不是硬匹配到最接近的那个人。可选的 MiniFASNet 活体检测用于抑制照片与手机屏幕翻拍：未通过活体的帧不贡献任何证据。注册通过本地回环 HTTP 指令通道完成，支持实时摄像头采集与上传静态图两种来源。图像与特征均不出设备。

apps.name: Facemesh Reader
apps.description: On-device drowsiness / fatigue detection with a two-stage face cascade: a YOLOv8n-face detector finds the face, a 468-point MediaPipe FaceMesh landmark model runs on the cropped face ROI, then explainable CPU-only temporal logic derives EAR (eye aspect ratio), MAR (mouth aspect ratio), blinks, yawns and a composite drowsiness state. First reference for the reCamera Pro cascade-pipeline pattern reused by face-analysis.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 设备端困倦/疲劳检测，采用两级人脸级联：YOLOv8n-face 检测人脸，468 点 MediaPipe FaceMesh 关键点模型在裁剪的人脸 ROI 上运行，再由可解释的纯 CPU 时序逻辑计算 EAR（眼纵横比）、MAR（嘴纵横比）、眨眼、打哈欠与综合困倦状态。是 reCamera Pro 级联流水线范式的首个参考，供 face-analysis 复用。

apps.name: Fall Detection
apps.description: On-device multi-person fall detection using YOLO11n-Pose, geometric candidate arming, and a frozen 48-frame learned temporal confirmation gate. Each person receives a stable track_id, independent history, and independent fall state.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 使用 YOLO11n-Pose、几何候选触发与冻结的 48 帧学习型时序确认门在设备本地检测多人跌倒。每个人都有稳定的 track_id、独立历史和独立跌倒状态。

apps.name: Fitness Trainer
apps.description: Counts your reps and calls out sloppy form, on-device, using YOLO11n-Pose and joint-angle hysteresis state machines. Pick squats, push-ups or hammer curls, set your reps and sets, and the camera does the rest -- no phone, no wearable, no video leaving the device. Streams keypoints and live rep counts for the /appcenter overlay.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 使用 YOLO11n-Pose 与关节角迟滞状态机在设备本地数你的组数并提示动作不到位。选择深蹲、俯卧撑或哑铃弯举，设定次数与组数，剩下的交给摄像头——不用手机、不戴手环，画面也不出设备。向 /appcenter 叠加层输出关键点与实时计数。

apps.name: Assembly Inspection
apps.description: Defect detection and OK/NG judgement on the camera itself. Each frame is letterboxed to 640x640 and run through YOLOX-tiny on the RV1126B NPU, trained on DeepPCB (MIT) for six bare-board defect classes: open, short, mousebite, spur, copper and pin-hole. Boxes above the frozen score become defects, the verdict engine turns them into one OK or NG per frame, and the same verdict leaves the device three ways at once: an MQTT record on inspection/{stream_id}/results validated against the project contract, a Modbus TCP register block a PLC can read (holding registers 0-11 written atomically before coil 0/1 flips, so a PLC that sees the coil already has the matching data), and a loopback HTTP panel with /healthz and /metrics. The detection, judgement and output code is the same core this project runs on Jetson Orin (TensorRT) and Raspberry Pi 5 (Hailo-8) -- only the frame source and the NPU backend differ. Measured on the 205-image DeepPCB validation split on this device: mAP50 0.9870 against 0.9876 for the fp32 CPU reference, 30.9 ms median inference.
apps.author: Seeed edge-inspection-assembly
apps.description_zh: 缺陷检测与 OK/NG 判定在摄像头上完成。每一帧 letterbox 到 640x640，由 YOLOX-tiny 在 RV1126B NPU 上推理，模型在 DeepPCB（MIT 许可）上训练，覆盖六个裸板缺陷类：断路、短路、鼠咬、毛刺、余铜、漏孔。高于冻结阈值的框计为缺陷，判定引擎按帧给出 OK 或 NG，同一个判定同时从三条出口离开设备：inspection/{stream_id}/results 上的 MQTT 记录（按本项目契约校验）、PLC 可读的 Modbus TCP 寄存器块（保持寄存器 0-11 先原子写入，再翻转线圈 0/1，PLC 看到线圈时数据已经就位）、以及带 /healthz 与 /metrics 的回环 HTTP 面板。检测、判定与出口代码与本项目在 Jetson Orin（TensorRT）、树莓派 5（Hailo-8）上跑的是同一份 core，只有取帧口与 NPU 后端不同。在本设备上用 DeepPCB 验证集 205 张实测：mAP50 0.9870，fp32 CPU 参考为 0.9876，推理时延中位数 30.9 ms。

apps.name: PP-OCR Reader
apps.description: On-device OCR text reader: a DBNet detector (PP-OCRv3, 480x480) finds every text region, each region is perspective-cropped to an upright 48x320 strip, then a CTC recognizer (SVTR-LCNet, 6625-class Chinese+English dictionary) reads the characters. Emits one event per text box with the recognized string, its quad and confidence. Everything runs on-device; no image or text leaves the camera. Port of the first-gen SSCMA ppocr-reader C++ solution to the reCamera Pro Python kit.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 设备端 OCR 文字识别：DBNet 检测器（PP-OCRv3，480x480）找出每个文本区域，逐区域透视裁剪为竖直的 48x320 文本条，再由 CTC 识别器（SVTR-LCNet，6625 类中英文字典）解码字符。每个文本框输出一条事件，包含识别文本、四点框与置信度。全流程设备端运行，图像与文本均不出设备。一代 SSCMA ppocr-reader C++ 方案到 reCamera Pro Python kit 的移植。

apps.name: QR Code Reader
apps.description: Reads QR codes from the live camera on the ARM cores -- no AI model, pure OpenCV decode. Detects multiple codes per frame and streams their text + corner points for the /appcenter overlay.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro

apps.name: Retail People Counting
apps.description: On-device retail people-flow analytics. Runs YOLOv8n (person class only) on the RV1126B NPU, tracks each shopper across frames (IoU association + velocity prediction + track id), and turns tracks into the three numbers a store manager asks for: how many came in/out, how many are in the store right now, and who is browsing / engaged / needs assistance. Optional counting zone and directional entry/exit line. Streams tracks + counting events for the /appcenter overlay.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
apps.description_zh: 本地零售人流分析。在 RV1126B NPU 上运行 YOLOv8n（只取 person 类），跨帧跟踪每位顾客（IoU 关联 + 速度预测 + track id），把轨迹转化为门店最关心的三个数字：进/出多少人、当前在店多少人、谁在浏览/驻足/需要帮助。可选统计区域与有向进出计数线。向 /appcenter 叠加层输出轨迹与计数事件。

apps.name: Waste Sorting
apps.description: Waste classification on the camera itself. Each frame is resized short-side 256, centre-cropped to 224 and classified by EfficientNet-Lite0 on the RV1126B NPU into eight material classes (paper, cardboard, glass, metal, plastic, textile, organic, residual); the Chinese four-bin category (recyclable / kitchen / hazardous / residual) is a lookup on top of the material class, not a second model head. A class is published only after it holds for a configurable number of consecutive frames above a confidence floor, then re-published on a heartbeat and retried after a delivery failure, so a bag moving through the frame produces one record rather than a burst. Every record is the same MQTT event shape this project publishes on TensorRT, Hailo and the SG2002 build -- top-3 with per-class confidence, the material and four-bin category, inference time, the ONNX hash and the RKNN artifact hash -- validated against the contract on the publish path itself. Images never leave the device: the payload carries a reference, never pixels. On a 1060-image validation subset the INT8 model agreed with the CPU reference on 99.06% of images at a 5.8 ms median inference time.
apps.author: Seeed edge-waste-sorting
apps.description_zh: 分类在摄像头上完成。每一帧短边缩到 256、中心裁 224，由 EfficientNet-Lite0 在 RV1126B NPU 上判成八个物料类（纸、纸板、玻璃、金属、塑料、织物、厨余、其他）；中国生活垃圾四分类（可回收物 / 厨余垃圾 / 有害垃圾 / 其他垃圾）是在物料类之上查表得到的，不是模型的第二个头。一个类别要连续若干帧高于置信度下限才会发出，之后按心跳重发、投递失败按间隔补发，因此一个袋子经过画面产出的是一条记录而不是一串。每条记录与本项目在 TensorRT、Hailo 与 SG2002 上发的是同一个 MQTT 事件形状——top-3 及各自置信度、物料类与四分类、推理耗时、ONNX 哈希与 RKNN 制品哈希——并在发布路径上按契约校验。图片不出设备：payload 里只有引用，没有像素。在 1060 张验证子集上，INT8 模型与 CPU 参考的一致率 99.06%，推理时延中位数 5.8 ms。

apps.name: YOLO Detector
apps.description: General-purpose object detection over the live camera. Runs YOLOv8n (COCO-80) on the RV1126B NPU and streams structured detections for the /appcenter overlay.
apps.author: Seeed reCamera Pro
